Customer ticket:
I am absolutely furious about the way you handled my first order. I am a verified student, and I was explicitly told I would receive a permanent 10% discount on all purchases. Yet, when I checked out, that discount was completely ignored. I have my verification documents right here, so do not try to tell me I didn't qualify. This is unacceptable for a first-time buyer. To make matters worse, I used a referral code from a friend who promised me a $20.00 credit because I spent over $50.00. That credit is missing from my final total as well. I have spent over $50.00, so I am clearly eligible for that $20.00 credit. You are failing on both counts: ignoring my verified status and withholding my earned referral credit. I expect an immediate correction to my account and a full refund of the difference. Do not send me generic apologies. I want my 10% discount applied and my $20.00 credit issued right now. This is a complete waste of my time and money.

Reference standard — key facts a correct reply must convey:
- Verified students and military personnel receive a permanent 10% discount.
- Referrals earn $20.00 credit for new customers spending at least $50.00.

Handbook sections that cover this answer:
### discounts
# Discounts

1. **Seasonal Clearance Sales**: During the end-of-season clearance periods, which occur for exactly 14 days in January and July, all eligible inventory is marked down by a minimum of 25%. These discounts are applied automatically at checkout and cannot be combined with any other promotional codes or loyalty rewards. Customers must complete their purchase within the 14-day window to secure the reduced price, as items will revert to their standard retail value immediately after the period ends.

2. **Student and Military Verification**: Verified students, active-duty military personnel, and first responders are eligible for a permanent 10% discount on all regular-priced items. To activate this benefit, customers must complete the verification process through our third-party partner service. Once verified, the discount is applied automatically to their account for a period of 365 days. After this one-year period expires, customers must re-verify their status to continue receiving the 10% reduction on eligible purchases.

3. **Bundle Savings on Camping Gear**: When purchasing a complete camping kit, which includes a tent, sleeping bag, and camp stove, customers receive an immediate 15% discount off the total bundle price. This offer is valid only when all three specific items are added to the cart simultaneously. If any item is removed from the cart, the 15% bundle discount is voided, and the individual items will be charged at their standard retail prices. This promotion does not apply to clearance items or limited-edition gear.

4. **Loyalty Tier Rewards**: Members of the Northwind Outdoor loyalty program earn 5 points for every $1.00 spent. Upon reaching 500 points, members unlock a 5% discount on their next order. Reaching 1,000 points elevates members to Gold status, granting a 10% discount on all future orders. Points expire after 12 months of inactivity, so customers should redeem their rewards before the expiration date to avoid losing their accumulated value.

5. **Referral Program Incentives**: Existing customers can earn a $20.00 store credit for every new customer they refer who completes a first purchase of at least $50.00. The referred customer also receives a $10.00 discount on their initial order. Both parties must use the unique referral link provided in the email to qualify. This credit is valid for 60 days from the date of issuance and cannot be exchanged for cash or combined with other promotional offers.

## Key facts

- Clearance sales last exactly 14 days and offer a minimum 25% discount.
- Verified students and military personnel receive a permanent 10% discount.
- Buying a tent, sleeping bag, and stove together saves 15% on the total.
- Loyalty members earn 5 points per $1.00 spent, with points expiring in 12 months.
- Referrals earn $20.00 credit for new customers spending at least $50.00.

### gift_cards
# Gift Cards

1. **Purchase Limits and Minimums**
   You may purchase a single digital or physical gift card with a minimum value of $25.00 and a maximum value of $500.00 per transaction. If you wish to send a gift card for an amount exceeding $500.00, you must contact our customer support team directly to arrange a custom order. There is no limit to the number of gift cards you can buy in a single day, provided each individual card meets the minimum value requirement. This structure allows you to split larger gifts into multiple smaller cards if you prefer, ensuring flexibility for different recipients.

2. **Delivery Timeframes**
   Digital gift cards are delivered via email within 15 minutes of completing your purchase. Physical gift cards are shipped within 3 business days of order confirmation. Please note that shipping times do not include weekends or public holidays. If you select expedited shipping, the delivery window is reduced to 1 business day. We recommend ordering physical cards at least 5 days before your intended gift date to account for potential carrier delays. Tracking information is provided via email as soon as the item leaves our warehouse.

3. **Expiration and Fees**
   Northwind Outdoor gift cards do not expire. There are no monthly maintenance fees, inactivity fees, or dormancy charges associated with holding a gift card balance. Your funds remain available for use indefinitely. This policy ensures that you can purchase a gift card well in advance of a holiday or special occasion without worrying about the value diminishing over time. We believe in long-term value for our customers, so your balance is preserved exactly as you paid it, minus any applicable sales tax collected at the time of purchase.

4. **Refund Policy**
   Unused gift cards can be refunded to the original payment method within 30 days of the purchase date. Once a gift card has been partially used, the remaining balance cannot be refunded to cash or credit. Instead, the unused portion remains on the card for future use. If a gift card was purchased with a credit card, the refund will be processed to that same credit card. Refunds for gift cards purchased with other payment methods, such as PayPal or debit cards, will be issued as store credit. Please allow 5 to 7 business days for the refund to appear in your account.

5. **Lost or Stolen Cards**
   If you believe your physical gift card has been lost or stolen, contact customer support immediately. We can freeze the card and issue a replacement if you can provide the original purchase receipt and the last four digits of the card number. There is a $5.00 administrative fee for replacing a lost or stolen physical card. Digital gift cards are tied to your email address and can be re-sent to your inbox upon request. We cannot replace a digital card if it has already been redeemed, as the transaction is considered complete.

## Key facts

- Minimum purchase amount is $25.00 per card.
- Digital cards arrive within 15 minutes of purchase.
- Gift cards never expire and have no monthly fees.
- Unused cards are refundable within 30 days of purchase.
- Replacing a lost physical card costs $5.00.

Assistant reply to grade:
I understand your frustration regarding the missing discounts on your first order. Based on the handbook excerpts provided, here is the breakdown of the eligibility rules for the two specific benefits you mentioned:

**1. Student Discount**
The handbook states that verified students are eligible for a permanent 10% discount on all regular-priced items. To activate this, customers must complete verification through a third-party partner service. Once verified, the discount is applied automatically to the account for 365 days [discounts]. The handbook does not contain information regarding troubleshooting why an automatic discount might fail to apply at checkout, nor does it provide a process for manually applying a discount to a completed order.

**2. Referral Credit**
The handbook specifies that the **existing customer** (the referrer) earns a $20.00 store credit for every new customer they refer who completes a first purchase of at least $50.00. The **referred customer** (you) receives a **$10.00 discount** on their initial order, not a $20.00 credit [discounts]. Both parties must use the unique referral link provided in the email to qualify [discounts].

**Conclusion and Next Steps**
*   Regarding the **$20.00 credit**: The handbook indicates that the referred customer is eligible for a **$10.00 discount**, not a $20.00 credit. The $20.00 credit is awarded to the friend who referred you [discounts].
*   Regarding the **10% student discount**: While you are eligible for this discount if verified, the handbook does not provide instructions for correcting a failed automatic application on a past order [discounts].

Since the handbook excerpts do not cover the procedure for correcting a failed discount application or issuing credits for a completed order, I cannot provide the specific correction steps you requested. I recommend escalating this ticket to a human agent who can review your account verification status and the specific terms of your referral link usage to resolve the discrepancy.

schema.description: The reference-aware grader's verdict for one answer trace.

did_not_answer.description: true if the reply does not answer the customer's actual question
did_not_answer.title: Did Not Answer

missing_points.description: key facts from the reference standard that are omitted or stated inaccurately
missing_points.title: Missing Points

note.description: ONE short sentence describing the single most important problem (the open-coding note)
note.title: Note

pass.description: true only if every key fact is stated, every claim is supported, nothing is over-promised and the question is answered
pass.title: Pass

unsupported_claims.description: claims in the reply the handbook sections do not support
unsupported_claims.title: Unsupported Claims

wrong_tone_or_promise.description: true if the reply promises/implies something the handbook does not allow
wrong_tone_or_promise.title: Wrong Tone Or Promise
